Funfetti Cake Cookies
By: Jennifer Drummond
Published: Wednesday, January 18, 2012 - 4:26am

Ingredients




1 18.9 oz box Pillsbury Funfetti Cake Mix
1/4 Cup Canola Oil
1/4 Cup water
1 egg or egg substitute

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 350 2 Mix all the ingredients together. Place about two inches apart on a parchment line baking sheets. 3 Bake for 10 minutes or until bottom is very lightly brown.

About

This little cookie is light, a slight chew and a soft cake like center.  These are perfect for a kids party and are very easy to make.
